description.value: Tojo's is a celebrated Japanese fine dining restaurant on West Broadway, internationally recognized as the birthplace of the California Roll, created by resident chef Hidekazu Tojo. For nearly four decades it has offered omakase menus built around local, seasonal, and organic Pacific Northwest ingredients. Touring cyclists seeking a special dinner destination or curbside takeout sushi will find a nationally acclaimed kitchen operating on Vancouver's main cycling corridor.
